question: Which district in Chhattisgarh was declared as India’s first child marriage-free district under the “Child Marriage Free India” campaign launched in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balod.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Balod district in Chhattisgarh has been officially declared as India’s first child marriage-free district__ under the Child Marriage Free India campaign.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **No cases of child marriage were reported in Balod over the last two years, leading to its certification.**
 
• **All 436 gram panchayats__ and __nine urban bodies__ of Balod were verified and certified child marriage-free.**
 
• **The milestone was achieved with collective effort of __administration, panchayats, Anganwadi workers, and communities__.**
 
• **District Collector Divya Umesh Mishra termed it a model for the country, with CM Vishnu Deo Sai calling it a historic reform.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Child Marriage Free India Campaign**__

 __
 
• Launched nationwide on 27th August 2024.
 
• Aims to eradicate child marriage by mobilising government and community support.
 
 
 
• **Chhattisgarh Government’s Goal**__
 __
 
• State aims to become fully child marriage-free by 2028-29.
 
 
 
• **Other District Initiatives**__
 __
 
• On PM Narendra Modi’s 75th birthday, 75 gram panchayats in Surajpur were declared child marriage-free.
 
 
 
• **UNICEF Role**__
 
 
• Provided technical support, awareness programs, and monitoring mechanisms.
